shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c 'cat .gitignore && git status --short && git ls-files && git diff --check && npm run build && npm run dev > /tmp/reading-room.log 2>&1 & server_pid=$!; for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 0.2; done; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | head -c 120; printf '"'\\n'; kill \""'$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; cat /tmp/reading-room.log'

/bin/bash -c "ps -eo pid,ppid,args | rg 'node server.js|npm run dev' || true; git status --short; git diff --check; nl -ba server.js | sed -n '1,235p'; printf '\\n--- app lines ---\\n'; nl -ba public/app.js | sed -n '1,300p'; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; nl -ba package.json"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: .gitignore
@@
 node_modules/
 __agent_eval__/
+/data/books.json
*** Add File: README.md
+# Reading Room
+
+A small, account-free bookshelf for books you're reading and books you've finished.
+
+## Run locally
+
+"'```sh
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000`. Books are stored in `data/books.json` and remain there when the server restarts. That file is kept out of Git so your personal titles and notes stay local.
+
+Each book has its own `/books/<id>` link. Share links with people who can reach the same running app.
*** End Patch
PATCH

git diff --check && node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && git status --short'
